sections.section_title: GPIO port bit reset register (GPIOx_BRR) (x = A, B, C, D, F)
sections.text_helper: Section 8.5.11 "GPIO port bit reset register (GPIOx_BRR) (x = A, B, C, D, F)" in chapter 8 (General-purpose I/Os (GPIO)), RM0490 Rev 6, page 194.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x28
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:16 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 15:0 BRy: Port x reset I/O y (y = 15 to 0)
These bits are write-only. A read operation always returns 0x0000.
0: No action on the corresponding ODx bit
1: Reset the corresponding ODx bit
